newsitem.title: USA: Tracor says unit gets $130 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Tracor says unit gets $130 mln contract.

text.p: Tracor Information Systems Co said on Wednesday that its Cordant segment had won four new contracts with a potential value of $130 million as part of a multiple award from the Virginia Contracting Activity.
Each of the contracts, which are indefinite delivery and indefinite quantity awards, will last either two or five years, the company said in a statement.
Tracor Information Systems is a unit of Tracor Inc.

"Cordant is pleased to have been chosen by VACA to provide the intelligence community with the equipment it has deemed essential to further its mission objectives," said Ken Johnson, chief executive officer and president of Cordant. Tracor
Inc, based in Austin, Texas, is a defense electronics firm with 1996 sales topping $1 billion.
